svg.title: SABSA security architecture — Finance, Defense and Agriculture domains combined
svg.desc: Three SABSA domain architectures stacked vertically: Finance, Defense, Agriculture, each with six layers.

g.text: Protect customer assets · prevent financial fraud · ensure regulatory compliance
PCI-DSS · Basel III · maintain brand trust · secure transactions
PII · card data classified as highly sensitive · encrypted at rest and in transit
Tokenisation for card numbers · data masking in non-production environments
Online banking: HTTPS · MFA · session timeout · CAPTCHA · OWASP compliance
Fraud detection engine · real-time transaction monitoring · secure APIs
HSM for key management · TLS 1.3 · firewall · WAF · DDoS mitigation
SIEM · secure API gateway · network segmentation · vulnerability scanning
Vault access control · ATM tamper detection · CCTV surveillance · secure data centre
Biometric entry · disaster recovery site · physical media destruction policies
Privileged access mgmt for tellers/analysts · dual control for high-value transactions
Insider threat monitoring · AML training · background verification
Compliance: PCI-DSS · Basel III · SOX · GDPR · RBI cybersecurity framework
Protect national security · safeguard classified info · ensure mission continuity
Secure interoperability with allied forces · comply with govt. security directives
Unclassified / Confidential / Secret / Top Secret classification levels
Mandatory access control · info labelling · secure destruction policies
C2 apps: end-to-end encryption · tamper detection · TEMPEST compliance
Secure messaging · coalition data sharing with strict access controls
Air-gapped classified networks · SDN segmentation · SCIF environments
Quantum-resistant encryption · secure satellite comms · cyber threat intel
Base perimeter fencing · armed guards · SCIF for classified ops · biometric entry
EM shielding · anti-drone measures · redundant power for critical infra
Tiered clearance levels · CAC smart card auth · vetting and background checks
Allied forces data sharing protocols · insider threat programme · OPSEC training
Compliance: NIST SP 800-53 · CMMC · ISO 27001 · government cybersecurity directives
Ensure food supply chain integrity · protect crop and yield data · prevent agri-fraud
Support sustainable practices · comply with food safety regulations
Crop yield data integrity · soil sensor readings tamper-proofing · supply chain provenance
Blockchain for end-to-end traceability · pesticide and fertilizer usage logs
Farm management platform: secure login · RBAC for farmers/inspectors/regulators
IoT firmware security · OTA update verification · data validation at edge
Secure IoT protocols (MQTT/TLS) · edge gateway firewalls · LoRaWAN security
Cloud-based farm analytics with encryption · anomaly detection for sensor data
Cold storage access control · grain silo tamper sensors · perimeter cameras
Secure packaging verification · drone surveillance · equipment locking
RBAC: farmer / agronomist / regulator / inspector with separate privileges
Cybersecurity training for field operators · vendor access mgmt · audit logs
Compliance: FSSAI · ISO 22000 · GDPR (farmer data) · IoT security standards · environmental regulations
